modifications: Design only; no code copied. Took Splash's suspendForGrowth/admitQueued shape: a blocked lane yields, its committed history is replayed through normal prefill, and while any preempted request waits admission recovers one lane at a time.
Victim is the youngest preemptible lane by first admission time (Splash: lowest priority, then least completed work).
Replay goes through mlx2's ordinary admission path and APCv2 lookup; the replay prefix is leased at preemption so pressure eviction cannot reclaim it while the job waits.

Added exactness gating Splash does not need: decode-phase lanes replay only when greedy or ordinary-route sampled (LaneRNG rebuilt from seed + delivered draws) and every logits processor declares history_pure; cohorts, parallel samples, capsules, multimodal, approximate, steered and int8-prefill decode lanes are never preempted.
Replay cap (2 per job) and drain cancellation (503) are mlx2 additions; the triggers are mlx2's existing stall watchdog plus a host pressure level.
validation: tests/test_suspend_replay.py (CPU: greedy decode/prefill, sampled ordinary and history-pure-processor replays token-identical on a tiny hybrid model; scripted stall/pause/cap/drain state machine)
